title: Instant Growth
description: Baby animals and villagers grow up instantly!
body: Baby animals and villagers grow up instantly! No 20 minute wait needed. Warning this mod is a datapack, tutorial on how to install a datapack here:[https://minecraft.fandom.com/wiki/Tutorials/Installing_a_data_pack#In_an_existing_world](https://minecraft.fandom.com/wiki/Tutorials/Installing_a_data_pack#In_an_existing_world)
